findings.issue: Frequent travel or shift work alone is not proof of jet lag/circadian indication; must distinguish sleep complaint, timing, and sedation risk.
Pregnancy safety gate only triggers if goal is sleep_rest, missing pregnant users considering melatonin for other reasons.
5-MTHF scores positive during pregnancy despite established neural-tube defect prevention evidence specific to folic acid.
5-MTHF scores positive in preconception without distinguishing evidence for folic acid.
Any medication causes cap E, but actual risk depends on medication class and renal status; risk cannot be inferred from generic boolean.
Sweat level alone insufficient for potassium supplementation.
Hydration/swallowing asked only after positive scoring; safety screening must precede suggestion.
Generic medications flag requires specific oral-drug absorption review.
Only triggers for already-taking vitamin A, misses prospective initiation of preformed retinol during pregnancy.
Smoking increases vitamin C requirements but positive score does not quantify diet or clinical context.
bone_joint_health not canonical goal; evidence for supplementation on bone outcomes is limited and context-specific.
Only checks explicit milk allergy; unknown allergen or unverified protein powder composition must fail closed.
Protein need should be assessed in g/kg/day and diet before product scoring.
Hair loss alone not established zinc deficiency.
Fish intake <=1 is a proxy and not universal clinical indication.
Strain-specific and condition-specific efficacy required; generic probiotics cannot inherit claims from other strains.
General wellness goal alone is insufficient for clinical benefit claim.
Already taking zinc is not equivalent to high total dose; verify elemental mg and duration.
Selenium excess can cause hair loss; do not infer benefit from symptom alone.
Multiple risk proxies do not establish serum deficiency or authorize personalized dosing.

additional_notes: Pregnancy planning and pregnancy rules must distinguish folic acid from 5-MTHF
All product lists must expand ingredient composition, rather than relying on product name
Medication interaction rules need generic name/class, not just medication boolean
Unmatched rules are not proof of safety; unknown data must fail closed
